name: Clockwork Spotter
body:
Price 6,950 gp; Slot none; CL 11th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura strong transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This tiny bird is made of intricate metals and delicate gears. On its back is a large metal key that can be cranked to bring it to life. Once per day as a full-round action, the key can be turned several times to activate the clockwork spotter. Once activated, it becomes a clockwork raven for 1 hour that’s capable of using find the path, locate object, and locate creature at will. While activated, anyone holding the spotter can impart their knowledge of a creature, place, or thing. The clockwork spotter will do its best to lead the holder to the target closest matching the description. After 1 hour, the spotter will lose all memory of its target, land, and deactivate.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,475 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells fabricate, locate creature, locate object
